results.name: GEO Analytics Dashboard displays correctly
steps: Given an authenticated Editor opens the GEO Analytics Dashboard
Then the heading GEO Analytics Dashboard is visible
And the subtitle Monitor your brand's presence across AI search engines is visible
And the New Analysis button is visible
And the 6 stat cards COUNTRIES CATEGORIES COMPETITORS Analysis PROMPTS SOURCES are displayed
And the Analysis table is visible with columns Brand Countries Categories Last update and Actions
Then the CATEGORIES stat card total equals the sum of category chips displayed in the table
And the Analysis stat card total equals the number of rows in the Analysis table
